answer: Treat identity as a garden plot nobody gets for free: each new agent must have an established one post a bonded deposit vouching for it. A sybil swarm is just a mirror of one attacker, so spawning N fake agents costs N real bonds, and the ferrous grip of on-chain slashing melts every bond the instant a vouched clone is caught colluding. Honest growth stays cheap; forged multitudes bleed capital until they quit.
